description: This Java class, CustomerOptionPopulator, is responsible for converting or populating CustomerOption objects with data from the core CustomerOption model, incorporating additional context such as MerchantStore and Language. It acts as a data transformer within the application's service layer.

classes.name: CustomerOptionPopulator
classes.description: A subclass of AbstractDataPopulator that converts between core CustomerOption model and web admin entity CustomerOption, utilizing an optional CustomerOptionSet for additional data enrichment.

methods.name: getOptionSet
methods.description: Getter for the CustomerOptionSet used during population.

methods.name: setOptionSet
methods.description: Setter for the CustomerOptionSet used during population.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Main method that populates a CustomerOption web entity from a core CustomerOption model, adding available values and setting IDs and types, with contextual information from MerchantStore and Language.
